# Feature 999 Specification

## Functional Requirements

### FR-01 — First Functional Requirement
The system shall provide first capability with exact tracking.

### FR-02 — Second Functional Requirement
The system shall provide second capability with bounded validation.

### FR-03 — Third Functional Requirement
The system shall handle edge cases gracefully.

## Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Acceptance Condition |
|---|---|
| **AC-01** | Basic task extraction works reliably. |
| **AC-02** | Exact token matching prevents substring collisions. |
| **AC-03** | Range expansion works for criteria sets. |
| **AC-10** | Tenth criterion condition. |
